card.name: Although after no-treatment statements
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "although" after a comma following a statement that there is no known treatment for tardive dyskinesia. Also fires on a few word starts such as V or VI in drug names and on a number.

modes.label: Although after TD statement
modes.description: The word "although" follows a comma after a sentence saying there is no known treatment for established tardive dyskinesia.
modes.example: There is no known treatment for established cases of tardive dyskinesia,<< although>> the syndrome may remit,

modes.label: Start of V-words
modes.description: A V or VI starting a brand name or a word like vomiting or antiviral.
modes.example: If PML is suspected, treatment with<< V>>ELSIPITY should be suspended until P

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens; the effect looks like mixed unrelated pieces.
card.plain: It mostly lights up on "although" in the line saying tardive dyskinesia has no known treatment, though it may remit.
